# Case Ledger Application Overview

## Business Role

Case Ledger supports the handling of service cases raised by internal
departments. It has been in daily use for more than eleven years.

Approximately 140 advisors record and process cases. Supervisors monitor
queues, reassign work, and review overdue cases. A small administration team
manages reference data, access profiles, and reporting schedules.

## Functional Areas

- Case intake and classification.
- Assignment to an advisor or team.
- Notes, tasks, and status history.
- Appointment scheduling.
- Attachment storage.
- Supervisor queues and saved searches.
- Weekly operational reporting.
- Reference-data and user administration.

## Modernization Intent

The organization wants a maintainable and secure application with clearer
workflows, dependable reporting, and technology that can be supported by the
current engineering team.

Case history and attachments must remain accessible. The organization has not
decided whether the modernization will replace the application at once or by
functional area.
